description: Figure 8 presents a pie chart illustrating the composition of total time cost, both before and after efficient deployment methods were applied. The chart consists of two pie segments representing time cost breakdowns. The first pie, labeled “Before Deployment”, is composed of two slices: a light-colored slice representing 26.2 seconds, and a darker-colored slice representing 60.9 seconds. The second pie, labeled “After Deployment”, is a single slice representing 26.2s, visually indicating a reduction in time cost. A legend is included, mapping the colors to the time cost components. Percentage labels are not displayed directly on the slices, but the text accompanying the figure states that the total time cost before deployment was 87.1 seconds and was reduced by 69.92% after deployment. The two pies are positioned adjacent to each other for visual comparison.
